applicableAreas: landscape plantings throughout site
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) identifies multiple trees requiring mitigation (marked SY, PL, M categories) within the site but does not provide root barrier detail specifications or dimensions anywhere in the plan set. Root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment per UCM § 1.10.10.4) must be shown on detail sheets for all trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of the underground electrical equipment.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations in parking courtyard and adjacent to buildings
findings.comment: Transformer pad locations (Sheet 21) include installations in the central courtyard area between Buildings 6 and 7, which is surrounded by parking structures, garages, and building overhangs. No cross-section drawings are provided demonstrating vertical clearances from transformer pads to parking structures, building overhangs, or other overhead elements. Cross-sections must be provided showing 35-foot minimum clearance for niche configurations or appropriate clearance for exposed pad locations.

applicableAreas: all 5 transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pad easement boundaries are not delineated on any site plan sheet. UCM § 1.10.3 requires transformer easements to be shown around all pads with width determined by Austin Energy Design for accessibility. The electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pad locations but provides no easement boundary annotations, widths, or reference to easement area calculations.

applicableAreas: all 5 transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions are not specified on any sheet. The electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows transformer pad locations with schematic symbols only, without dimensions (length × width). No service type (single-phase or three-phase) is specified. AE Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets required for the specified equipment must be provided to verify pad dimensions comply with Austin Energy requirements.

applicableAreas: central courtyard transformer pad between Buildings 6 and 7
findings.comment: A transformer pad is located in the central courtyard area (between Buildings 6 and 7) that is immediately adjacent to and within parking/vehicle circulation areas (fire lane designation shown on Sheet 10). No bollard specifications, details, or placement drawings are provided. UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 requires 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) when equipment pad is installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes, with spacing that allows equipment door opening. Provide AE Design-approved bollard detail showing specifications, spacing, and orientation.

applicableAreas: all 5 transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pads are shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not shown on site plan (Sheet 9) with dimensions and clearance annotations. No distances are dimensioned from transformer pad edges to buildings, structures, or foundations. Clearance compliance cannot be verified without dimensional callouts from transformer pads to adjacent structures.

applicableAreas: retaining wall locations throughout site
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on grading plan (Sheet 11) at site perimeter and around pond area. Transformer pad locations not shown on grading plan. No dimensions provided from transformer pads to retaining walls to verify 5-foot clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: if fences present adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Fence locations shown on site plan but transformer pad locations not shown with respect to fences on the same sheet. Access door orientation of transformer pads not indicated. Cannot verify clearances (5 feet for sides with operators/controls, 3 feet for sides without) without coordinate dimensioning.

applicableAreas: if clearances less than 5 feet to buildings are proposed
findings.comment: No clearances are dimensioned on electrical plan. No evidence of reduced clearance conditions (3-foot exception to buildings) or supporting AE Design written approval documentation. Cannot determine applicability without dimensional data from transformer pads to buildings.

applicableAreas: transformer pad locations adjacent to buildings
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets showing balconies, overhangs, and vertical clearance dimensions are not provided in the site plan set. Transformer pad locations not shown in relation to building elevations. Cannot verify 5-foot lateral clearance from balconies or overhead structure prohibitions without elevation drawings.

applicableAreas: if windows, doors, or ventilating ducts present on adjacent buildings
findings.comment: Building elevations showing window and door locations are not provided. Transformer pad lateral and horizontal distances to windows/doors not dimensioned. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified. Cannot verify 12-foot clearance requirement without elevation details and equipment specifications.

applicableAreas: sidewalk locations adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Sidewalk locations are shown on site plan and grading plan. Transformer pads not shown on same sheets with dimensions. No clearance dimensions provided from transformer pad edges to sidewalk back-of-curb lines.

applicableAreas: if fire exit stairwells present adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Fire exit stairwell locations not shown or identified on site plan, fire protection plan, or building floor plans provided. Transformer pad locations not dimensioned relative to building exits. Cannot verify clearances without building plans showing stairwell locations.

applicableAreas: if fire escapes or emergency stairs present
findings.comment: Fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes are not identified on fire protection plan (Sheet 10) or building elevations. Transformer pads not shown on fire protection plan. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified. Cannot verify 20-foot clearance requirement without identification of fire escape locations and equipment specifications.

applicableAreas: all 5 transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions not provided. Access door orientation not shown or indicated. Hot-stick use area (10-foot clearance zone from access door) cannot be delineated without knowing pad dimensions and access door location. Clearance compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: if transformer locations face confined spaces
findings.comment: No niche, vault, or enclosed area configurations are shown for any transformer locations. Access door orientation not indicated. 15-foot clearance requirement for confined space (15+ foot vertical clearance vs. 10-foot standard) cannot be applied or verified without identification of confined space conditions and access door orientation.

applicableAreas: fire hydrant locations on site
findings.comment: Fire hydrants are shown on fire protection plan (Sheet 10) - 2 proposed on-site and 1 existing off-site. Transformer pads are shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not on fire protection plan. No dimensions provided between fire hydrant locations and transformer pad locations. Clearance compliance cannot be verified without coordinate dimensioning.

applicableAreas: tree planting areas throughout site
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows trees categorized by type (SY, PL, P, M) but does not provide specific species names or identification against ECM Appendix F utility-compatible column. Transformer pad locations not shown on landscape plan. No tree species list provided separately. Utility compatibility per ECM Appendix F cannot be verified without species identification and transformer pad proximity verification.

applicableAreas: shrub and low-lying vegetation areas on site
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows shrub areas and vegetation but transformer pad locations not shown on landscape plan. Access door orientation of transformer pads not indicated. Clearances (10 lateral feet from access door side, 5 feet from other sides) cannot be verified without transformer location overlay and access door identification.

applicableAreas: if dumpster locations present
findings.comment: Dumpster locations shown on site plan. Transformer pad locations not shown on site plan with dimensional references. Cannot verify 5-foot clearance requirement without coordinate dimensioning from transformer pads to dumpster enclosures.

applicableAreas: if bike racks present adjacent to transformers
findings.comment: Bike rack locations shown on site plan. Transformer pad locations not shown on site plan. No dimensions provided between bike racks and transformer pad locations. Cannot verify 5-foot clearance requirement without coordinate details.

applicableAreas: if light poles adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Light poles may be indicated on site plan and electrical plan but transformer pad locations not dimensioned relative to lighting fixtures. Cannot verify 5-foot clearance requirement without specific coordinate dimensioning.

applicableAreas: fire lane areas adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Fire lanes are clearly shown and dimensioned on fire protection plan (Sheet 10) - 26 feet to 27.3 feet wide. Transformer pads shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not on fire protection plan. Transformer pad locations appear adjacent to fire lanes based on electrical plan layout but exact distances from fire lane boundaries not dimensioned. 15-foot clearance requirement cannot be verified without overlay dimensioning.

applicableAreas: all 5 transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are identified on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but no dimensions are provided between them. Spacing/clearances between pads cannot be verified. Minimum 5-foot pad-to-pad clearance requirement cannot be confirmed without dimensional callouts.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Water lines (8-inch main and service lines) are shown and labeled on utility tap plan (Sheet 19) with material specifications. Transformer pads are shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not shown on utility plan. No clearance dimensions between water lines and transformer pad locations. Compliance with 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Wastewater lines (8-inch and 6-inch PVC and DI) are shown on utility tap plan (Sheet 19). Transformer pads shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not on utility plan. No dimensions provided between wastewater lines and transformer pads. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Storm drain lines (shown as green 'SD' lines) are depicted on utility tap plan (Sheet 19). Transformer pads shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not on utility plan. No distances dimensioned between storm drain lines and transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: if gas service is present
findings.comment: Gas infrastructure not shown on utility tap plan or site plan. Gas service type and location not specified. Transformer pad locations not shown on utility plan. Clearance requirement (24-36 inches depending on pressure) cannot be evaluated without identification of gas lines and pressure specifications.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Underground utilities (water, wastewater, storm drain) shown on utility tap plan (Sheet 19). Transformer pads shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not on utility plan. No horizontal or vertical clearance dimensions provided between other underground utilities and transformer pad locations. Minimum 12-inch clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: if utility conflicts present
findings.comment: Underground utilities shown on utility tap plan. Transformer pads shown on electrical plan but not on utility plan. No elevation references or vertical separation details provided at utility crossings. Over/under installations and conflicts with AE facilities cannot be determined without complete utility coordination drawing.

applicableAreas: overhead distribution line area on south side of site
findings.comment: Overhead electric line shown on southern boundary of electrical plan (Sheet 21). Transformer pad locations not shown with dimensional references to overhead conductors. No sky-to-ground clearance dimensions provided. Minimum 7.5-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified without specific coordinate dimensioning.

applicableAreas: overhead distribution conductor area on site
findings.comment: Overhead electric line shown on site plan but transformer pad locations not dimensioned relative to conductor centerline. 15-foot radius clearance requirement (measured from conductors, not pole) cannot be verified without specific distance callouts from transformer pad edges to conductor positions.

applicableAreas: all transformer pad locations if oil-filled
findings.comment: Grading plan (Sheet 11) shows surface drainage direction with flow arrows for all site areas. Transformer pad locations not shown on grading plan. Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified on electrical plan. Drainage direction requirement (liquid flow away from buildings for oil-filled equipment) cannot be verified without transformer location overlay on grading plan and equipment type specification.

applicableAreas: all 5 transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Transformer pads shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not shown on site plan (Sheet 9) with dimensional relationship to property lines. Plat shown on Sheet 2 but transformer locations not dimensioned on plat or site plan. Cannot verify that 100% of transformer pads are located on private property without coordinate dimensioning from pads to property boundaries.

applicableAreas: all 5 transformer pad locations in relation to easements
findings.comment: Grading plan (Sheet 11) shows multiple easements (drainage, wastewater, water/wastewater, sidewalk, utility) at various site locations. Transformer pads shown on electrical plan (Sheet 21) but not shown on grading plan with easement boundaries. Transformer pad placement relative to easement areas cannot be verified without dimensional overlay. Written approvals from Austin Energy for any pad placements within easement areas are not provided.

applicableAreas: electrical service routing from all transformers to meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformers to meters not detailed on site plan. Transformer locations not dimensioned relative to property lines. Path of electrical conduit routing not shown with property boundary verification. Cannot confirm that 100% of electrical routing from transformer to meter is on private property without detailed coordination drawings.

applicableAreas: if buildings or structures installed under overhead distribution facilities
findings.comment: Overhead electric line shown on site boundary (Sheet 21). Building footprints shown but no dimensional clearances from buildings to overhead conductor positions. Cannot verify that no customer facilities (buildings, parking garages, light poles, signs, tanks, antennas) are installed under overhead distribution facilities without specific coordinate dimensioning.
